label: The Most Beautiful Field of Flowers

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The Third Surface Reclamation War ended in a victory.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The Ark ascended, the Queen was defeated, and Raptures are nowhere to be seen.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: There wasn't a single civilian casualty.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: It's a miracle.
Have you heard anything from Enikk about what happens next?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Yes. She told me about the Seven Arbiters and the Queen.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: She said the planet has only twenty years left. It honestly doesn't feel real.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We'll have to keep an eye on the situation for now.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The first order of business is managing the Ark. We have a handful of problems to sort through.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We can start taking action once things have been stabilized here to some degree.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: In the meantime, you and all our other main forces need to get some rest.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Don't move around more than you need to.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I get that you're anxious, but you need rest.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: It's not good to stir up the Ark right now, for a variety of reasons.
All right.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Good. Now let's move on to discussing the unknown Nikkes that fought in the battle.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Cinderella, Little Mermaid, Grave, Hansel, and Gretel.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I heard they're second-generation Grimms models, but I can't find any records about them anywhere.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: There's nothing in the Forbidden Library either.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The only information I have is what you and your cohort have told me.
But...!

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That means we're going to officially register them.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Their squad name is Old Tales.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: They'll be serving under you. No one but you can give Old Tales any orders.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Not the Central Government, not the Big Three, no one.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Of course, there was a lot of discussion over whether it's appropriate to put such a powerful squad under an individual's command,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: but the individual in question is you.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We're going to hold a meeting about this, and I hope you'll push hard for this to go through.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I don't think anyone will object. Rather, I don't think anyone can object.
Thank you...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I'm also wary of one individual carrying so much power,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: but I'm less worried if it's you.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You're the one Andersen left everything to, after all.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We'll continue to treat Old Tales, so don't worry about that.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: M.M.R. has offered their enthusiastic cooperation, so we'll wait and see.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Next is the matter of the Crown Kingdom.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: They've made an alliance with the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We agreed to heal Crown and guarantee the kingdom's autonomy,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: and in exchange, they agreed to supply the Ark with superfood.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: The Ark was essentially facing a food shortage, so getting the superfood seeds is huge for us.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Thanks to them, that's one thing off our plate.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Next up... Marian.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I'm going to ban anyone from going near the black moon she made.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Nobody could do anything to harm such a dense ball of Dark Matter,

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: but there still might be people who take an interest and try something.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Next, Eden.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We agreed to form an alliance with Eden.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Since we both have an Ultra Massive Core, our lives are in each other's hands.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Eden is, more or less, a powerful armed militia located on the surface.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We need to cooperate with them, while also keeping them in check.
Is the Ark going to keep using its core?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: No. We have to switch to an alternative as quickly as possible.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We can't have the entire Ark relying on something so dangerous.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: In the past, we didn't have a choice, but things are different now.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We've got plenty of other options.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Well... That does it for now.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Do you have any questions?
What will happen to the Goddess Squad?

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We're going to invite them to the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... They should set foot in the place they worked so hard to protect.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We'll give them a grand welcome.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Of course, that will have to happen after the Ark has stabilized a bit.
... Okay. Sounds good.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Andersen...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: No. There's no need to say any more.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: He made a choice that was true to him.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I only regret that I couldn't say goodbye.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I'm going to miss him.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: He was my idol.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... It's going to be even lonelier now as the only deputy chief left in the Ark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: I don't suppose you would...

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: No. We'll talk later.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You're free to go now.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Get some rest. I mean it.
Yes, sir.
Do you know what Enikk is doing right now? I'd like to thank her for her hard work.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: She's busy.
Ah... You must be pouring all resources into stabilizing the Ark. I understand.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: No, it's not because of that.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: She's focusing her resources on something I suppose you could say is even more important.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You've done a great job.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: We'll talk more later.
I walk through the Ark's city streets.
A breeze blows.
It's not a synthetic breeze created by Enikk, but the wind of the surface.
There's so much that needs to be done,
but we ascended.
We did it.
We won.
I rummage around in my pocket.
I pull out the black butterfly that Marian gave me and gaze at it.
Marian...
I'm going to get her back
no matter what it takes.
Nayuta stares up idly at the black moon.
She doesn't look around her. Her gaze is fixed.
Soon, she feels an outside presence.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Nayuta.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Nayuta.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Don't take another step.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh, you finally decided to respond?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe. I'm just a digital life-form. I couldn't hurt you even if I came close to you.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: My mood is foul. Do not move.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hmm... Sure, okay.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: What brings thee here?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Now that Marian has become the only Queen, I can probably be of some help to her.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Unlike the last Queen, she's actually trying to restore the world to normal.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: There are many ways I could help, like providing her information about the Seven Arbiters.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The moment thy Queen departeth thou dost seek another.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh, come on. You make it sound like a bad thing. My goal has always been simple.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Indeed, thou didst not serve anyone.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou didst simply control the Queen in secret and attempt to affect the world.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet thou didst not show thy true self to anyone.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: There is a question that hath vexed me.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Why did the Queen seek to destroy humanity?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Because she was broken.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She was part human, part AI, part Rapture, and part Nikke.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It's no wonder she didn't think normally.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I also think getting attacked by humans left quite the impression on her.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She must have judged them to be the greatest obstacle to achieving her goals.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Why art thou so obsessed with controlling from the shadows?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Because my original personality data failed after it revealed itself. That experience has taken root deep inside me.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: But thou must know.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen was a simple construct, but Young Lady Marian is different.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: She doth possess her own mind and will.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: She will never be swayed by an unknown entity such as thee.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You're right. And Marian already hates me.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That's why I'd like you to be the messenger and pass along my words.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You can even take all the credit for yourself.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I'll just provide the information.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou wouldst gain nothing from this arrangement.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That's true... for now. I joined the wrong side, and now... I need to pay for it.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Mirror.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: What is thy goal?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: No. What art thou?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I'm a data life-form that was created incidentally.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Just a string of ones and zeroes that can never have a true form,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: yet somehow managed to become sentient.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And now that thing wants to prove itself, and the only way it can is by using others.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: A parasite by necessity.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: An entirely unknown entity.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Ah, it would've been so nice to have a body.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I would've thrown myself into everything, to the point where my body broke.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It would've been so nice not to be conscious.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I would've just obeyed the orders given to me.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It would've been so nice...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: to have never been made at all.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I could've gotten away from all of this.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou wert thus born and hast no choice but to live accordingly.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Yeah, basically.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: We have spent much time together,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: but it feels as though thou hast revealed thyself to me for the first time.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Well, I bear no interest.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Commencing hacking.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ...! Enikk!

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: What's she doing here...?!
*Crackle*
Static appears in Mirror's body.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Wait, don't—

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: That was fast.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: It was not a very sophisticated program. My thorough preparations were rather meaningless.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Total destruction is possible at any time. Are you sure about this decision?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Removing her capacity for language will be sufficient.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: She doth possess much information. 'Twould be a pity to erase it all.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: She was clearly designed so that all her information would disappear along with her.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Didst thou locate her information stores?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Yes. I have confirmed the coordinates of her databases.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: There are 4,190 of them.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I copied them all, and then deleted them from her.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis rather a large number. It will be quite a task to open them all.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I shall delete her now.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: No. Leave her as is.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This is most apt.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Now, Young Lady Mirror.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall now explain simply how this came to pass.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Well, now thou canst do naught but listen anyhow. Haha.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou didst underestimate the Ark.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This place is quite far from the Ark, but as soon as they did ascend, they rapidly expanded their territory.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: This place will naturally fall under their territory as well.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: As part of the Ark's territory, this place is also a part of Young Lady Enikk's jurisdiction.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: How lamentable. Hadst thou possessed a physical form, thou wouldst have observed the device laid on the ground.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: There is something I have deduced about thee.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The reason thou dost hide they form, reveal it only to few,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and refuse contact with those related to the Ark...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Perhaps it is in thy nature to scheme in secret,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: but I believe it is because thou dost fear Young Lady Enikk.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: With thy petty spirit, thou canst not stand against Young Lady Enikk.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Take what happened earlier in the blink of an eye as proof.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Hm? What face doth thou make? Art thou incensed?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Pray tell, why? In the end, 'twas not a one-way transfer of information between thee and me.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I simply used this information more effectively. And yet what a face thou dost make...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Tell me why. I shall attend.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Faith, why dost thou not speak?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Haha, what art thou saying?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I'm glad you're enjoying yourself.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Oh. Apologies for my flippant demeanor.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Is there any chance of Young Lady Mirror's trickery affecting any other Nikkes?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Perhaps she retains the ability to print text.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Ever since the Sixo incident, we have been perfectly prepared for such a possibility.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: The entity called Mirror will have no such effect.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Excellent.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Enikk, I thank thee for handling the mess I did create.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No need to thank me.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I have not analyzed all your actions,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: but I know you have acted for the public good.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: While the results have not always been favorable, I have no doubt as to your intentions.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... I thank thee.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, from now on I would recommend engaging in sufficient discussion and data sharing before proceeding.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Understood. I shall keep this in mind.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: As for what I did,

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: it is insignificant when compared to helping the Maria-model Nikke become Queen and thereby initiating the proper process.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I am glad our former plan failed.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis a great relief.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet what I have done cannot be forgiven, so I must work hard to atone.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall put everything on the line.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou must help me, Young Lady Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Now then...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I shall begin by securing the location where the nearest of the Seven Arbiters is.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Young Lady Enikk... Wouldst thou be interested in clone production?
White flowers.
Only white flowers and nothing else.
The white flowers that cover the hill gleam in the sunlight.
Their petals are carried on the ocean breeze.
*Rustle*
The sea breeze blows once again.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Wow. How did you find this place?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: You'd be surprised at what a small abuse of power can do.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Hahaha. Is that why you became a deputy chief?
Liliweiss walks through the field of white flowers.
At the bottom of the hill, the sea spreads out endlessly.
The breeze blows again.
White flower petals dance around Liliweiss and Andersen.
Andersen slowly walks behind Liliweiss.
He stops beside her, and they both gaze out at the ocean.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Do you regret it?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I've never regretted anything in my life.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Liar.
Andersen looks at Liliweiss.
She looks back at him.
Andersen gazes silently at her.
He idly watches the most beautiful white flower in the world.
He takes in the sight
that missed and loved for so long.
They don't have much time left.
He spends all that time watching the white flower.
Liliweiss meets his gaze.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Aren't you going to kiss me?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: No, because then I'd have to close my eyes.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: You're going to wear your eyes out.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Then I'll keep looking at you until they wear out and disappear.
The two stare silently at each other.
They gaze at the last thing they will ever see.
And they talk.
They say the words that they always wanted to say, but that always brought sorrow and despair with them.
However, now they hold nothing but happiness.
They cover the sorrow and despair with joy
and speak.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I love you, Lilith.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I love you too, Andersen.
*Rustle*
The sea breeze blows, sending the white petals dancing.
They dance and dance.
After letting the wind carry them, the petals fall.
In that place,
there is a field of white flowers by the sea.
And in that place,
there is the most beautiful white flower in the world.
